newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps hold steady, in sideways market.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps hold steady, in sideways market.

text.p: European oil swaps were broadly steady on Thursday with Brent CFDs holding, naphtha unchanged and gasoline and fuel hovering around Wednesday's levels.
Dealers said there was little driving the market.
Brent CFDs were seen at +7 cents against August for July 7-11 while July 14-18 was put at -10 cents against August and July 21-25 was assessed at -14 cents. July 28 to August 1 was put at -18 cents.
Gas oil crack spreads were also steady with 4Q97 at $4.45, 1Q98 at $4.58 and 2Q98 at $4.10.
Heavy fuel swaps were pegged around $85.00 for July with August at a $1 contango. Wet barges were heard traded at $84 and $85 for Rotterdam refinery material.
Low sulphur swaps were around $94.00 for July with August showing a slender contango of 75 cents or so and August a further 75 cents firmer.
Gasoline swaps were steady with dealers commenting on slow business. July was put at $188 with August backwardated by $1 or so and September lower by a further dollar.
